principle: Hard Radar and EcoRadar must never degrade or silently overwrite each other or the working MIRLEX Engine. Both feed one knowledge core through independent source registries and a validation/promotion gate.

guards.stable_ids: Do not rename/reuse hard radar IDs; amend existing records with new evidence.
guards.cross_radar_dedup: Before announcing or ingesting a new finding, compare both radar indexes, existing engine knowledge, canonical act identifier, factual pattern and permanent IDs.
guards.provenance: Preserve primary-source URLs, document versions, original source IDs, verification status and commit SHA; never delete historical evidence to reconcile a conflict.
guards.legal_time_gate: Distinguish draft, approved future, in-force, repealed, guidance, unconfirmed. Never promote a draft or unverified claim as current obligation.
guards.conflicts: Conflicting rules/source dates enter HOLD_FOR_REVIEW; preserve last verified working rule until resolution and successful tests. A verified repeal/supersession must flag affected old rules for revalidation, not silently leave obsolete rules active.
promotion_gate: validate current primary law and effective dates
resolve same-topic records and references across radars
determine affected industries and existing Engine rule IDs
run regression and cross-expert routing tests
preserve last known good working version and rollback reference
commit new candidate and re-read from GitHub
activate only after all gates pass
guards.rollback: If any gate fails, keep the last known good ACTIVE rule unchanged and store the finding as RESEARCH_ONLY or BLOCKED_PENDING with a durable pointer.
guards.expert_visibility: ECO_EXPERT and ROP_EXPERT may read verified active rules; research signals may inform questions only when clearly flagged and must not create legal obligations.
guards.independent_operation: Failure of one radar, external source, or indexing must not stop the other radar or corrupt Engine; queue retryable pending items and report only validated operational states.
integrity_checks: index entries resolve to existing paths
source status and effective date match live rule provenance
no active rules based solely on unconfirmed/draft signals

scope: Governance contract only. Does not implement runtime enforcement until verified through tests and deployment.
